title: Lockdown Mode
summary: OpenAI's Lockdown Mode is a security feature that allows organizations to restrict access to their data and limit certain AI capabilities to enhance privacy and compliance controls in enterprise environments.
problem_solved: Addresses enterprise security concerns by providing controlled access restrictions to prevent unauthorized data exposure and ensure compliance with organizational policies.
why_valuable: Enables organizations to safely deploy AI tools in sensitive environments while maintaining strict data governance and access controls, critical for regulated industries.
